prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>: a Chinese man about 26 years old with a lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, a clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features, wearing a plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned dark blue-gray casual overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers. Here he wears a simple black commuting backpack.

summary:
[reference generation] The camera follows <Subject 1> from behind as he walks out through a quiet office corridor at dusk with his backpack.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his natural short black hair, lean build, unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers are retained, seen from behind, with the black backpack added.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field and restrained contrast, in cool blue-gray evening tones.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide tracking shot from behind shows <Subject 1> walking away from the camera down a clean, quiet office corridor at dusk. He is centered in the frame and seen from head to knees: his natural short black hair, the simple black commuting backpack worn on both shoulders over his unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt, his black straight-leg trousers and, as he steps, his white sneakers. The corridor has a pale gray floor that softly reflects the lights, white walls on the right and a long glass wall on the left. Through the glass wall, the floor-to-ceiling windows of the office show a dark-blue evening skyline with lit windows and a thin last band of orange light. Recessed ceiling lights run in a line down the corridor toward a pair of glass doors at the far end. He walks at a calm, ordinary pace, his arms swinging naturally, the backpack straps moving slightly with each step; he does not turn around. The corridor is empty apart from him. The camera tracks behind him with small amplitude at slow speed, keeping the same distance as he walks toward the glass doors, so his figure stays the same size in the frame. His shadow falls softly on the floor ahead of him. The lighting stays even and cool for the whole shot, with soft reflections of the ceiling lights on the floor and on the glass. There is no text anywhere in the frame, and the signs on the doors are blank.

overall_soundscape: His soft footsteps squeak lightly on the polished corridor floor over quiet building ventilation, and the backpack straps rustle faintly.

non_diegetic_music: Ambient electronic music: sustained synth pads at a slow tempo over a soft, steady low pulse, kept low in volume.
